name: Frappe Bench
postCreateCommand: uv tool install pre-commit && git config --global user.signingkey /home/frappe/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub && git config --global gpg.format ssh && git config --global commit.gpgsign true && git config --global gpg.ssh.allowedSignersFile /home/frappe/.ssh/allowed_signers && echo "$(git config --global user.email) namespaces=\"git\" $(cat /home/frappe/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub)" > /home/frappe/.ssh/allowed_signers && if [ -f /home/frappe/.ssh/id_ed25519 ] && ! ssh-keygen -y -P "" -f /home/frappe/.ssh/id_ed25519 >/dev/null 2>&1; then (ssh-agent -s > /home/frappe/.ssh-agent.env && eval "$(cat /home/frappe/.ssh-agent.env)" && (grep -qF "source /home/frappe/.ssh-agent.env" /home/frappe/.bashrc || echo "source /home/frappe/.ssh-agent.env" >> /home/frappe/.bashrc) && (ssh-add /home/frappe/.ssh/id_ed25519 < /dev/tty 2>/dev/null || echo "SSH key is passphrase-protected: run 'ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519' in your terminal to unlock it.")) || true; else echo "SSH key not found or not passphrase-protected - skipping ssh-agent setup."; fi
